summary: Apogee Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a Revenue Participation Right Purchase and Sale Agreement with an affiliate of Blackstone Life Sciences on May 26, 2026. The agreement provides Apogee with up to $800 million in tranched funding ($100M upfront, $100M at Phase 3 enrollment, $200M at positive data, $250-400M at FDA approval) in exchange for tiered revenue share payments on net sales of zumilokibart, an anti-IL-13 antibody. This is a financing arrangement, not a corporate control or structural event. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for milestone triggers and dilution of future cash flows.
